👨‍🌾Welcome to Build A Farm!🐑

The long-awaited sequel is here!
Grab your boots and build the farm of your dreams in Build A Farm!
Feed cute animals, grow and harvest ultra-rare crops 🌱✨, and become the richest farmer in town!

Join the Sylica group for awesome perks:
- +5% income 💰 
- +1.5 walk speed 🚶‍♂️💨 
- FAN chat tag ⭐

Leave a like 👍 & favourite ⭐ the game if you'd like to see more updates!

Farming has never been this fun — can you grow your way to the top in this tycoon?

This experience was brought to you by Sylica🐔
